output.markdown:
## Saturday 21 Dec 2024 taxi trips were essentially unchanged despite heavy snowfall

Trips on 2024-12-21 (131,279) were +0.15% versus the mean of the other three December Saturdays (131,087). Snowfall on 2024-12-21 was 46 mm, while the other Saturdays had 0 mm. Average fare on 2024-12-21 was -3.52% vs the other Saturdays.

**Recommendation:** Monitor future snow events against the established baseline; the data shows no measurable trip reduction from snow on 21 Dec 2024. If policy responses are needed, focus on fare stability rather than trip volume changes.

### Evidence-backed claims
1. Trip count on 2024-12-21 was +0.15% versus the mean of the other three December Saturdays. [Q1 · sha256:43aa38fafed77514 · whybot.yellow_daily]
2. Snowfall on 2024-12-21 was 46 mm vs 0 mm on the other three December Saturdays. [Q2 · sha256:aaef9b097f363689 · whybot.nyc_weather_daily]
3. Average fare on 2024-12-21 was -3.52% versus the mean of other Saturdays. [Q5 · sha256:999384b4bf1666a5 · whybot.yellow_daily]

### Caveats
- The percentage differences are derived from the mean of three comparison Saturdays; different comparison sets could yield different values.
- Yellow taxi trips may be offset by green/for-hire vehicle trips not captured in this dataset.
- Snowfall data covers calendar day; evening commute impacts may differ from daily aggregate.
- The other three December Saturdays (7, 14, 28) all had zero snowfall, limiting the comparison set.
- Data quality (not evidence): the TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday flag disagrees with Nager.Date on 4 date(s): 2024-11-11: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Veterans Day (national holiday); 2024-11-28: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Thanksgiving Day (national holiday); 2024-12-31: TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday=Y but Nager.Date says no national holiday; 2025-01-20: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day (national holiday). Holidays come from Nager.Date only [DQ1 sha256:c05513fae1456cc0].

_Confidence 0.88. Data source: LIVE Zetaris Lightning (JDBC)._

hypotheses.refute_if: avg_total_amount on 2024-12-21 within 5% of baseline average.
